source: NWS NDFD (graphical.weather.gov ndfdXMLclient.php, time-series) and Open-Meteo (api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast), a 3x2 lattice over 121W-117W, 31N-33N: San Diego's coast and the sea west of it

traps.ndfd-days.xml: offshore points (121W, 119W) answer nil; after 20:00 local the first maximum is tomorrow's
traps.ndfd-hour.xml: begin sent with its Z; without it NDFD reads the hour as each point's local time
traps.ndfd-days-wind.xml: captured 2026-09-27T17:39Z with wspd and wdir: hourly sustained wind in knots, its first hour the next hour
traps.openmeteo-wind.json: captured 2026-09-27T17:39Z with wind: hourly km/h and degrees, each day's peak and dominant direction
traps.openmeteo.json: every point answered, the sea included; hours in each point's local time with its offset
traps.openmeteo-rain-days.json: captured 2026-09-27T21:35Z over south-east Alaska (135W-131W, 57N-59N): its points in two zones, Alaska's and British Columbia's an hour apart, so each day's heaviest hour is read on the point's own date; rain and showers apart, snowfall in cm
traps.openmeteo-rain-hours.json: captured 2026-09-27T21:35Z, forecast_hours=4: the current hour first, in each point's zone
traps.openmeteo-feels.json: captured 2026-09-27T23:51Z with apparent_temperature hourly and each day's max and min (D-119)
traps.ndfd-days-feels.xml: captured 2026-09-27T23:51Z with appt: hourly apparent temperature from the next hour, every few hours later; no daily value
traps.ndfd-hour-feels.xml: captured 2026-09-27T23:51Z with appt and begin: NDFD ignores begin for appt and answers from the next hour, so Now's feels-like is not in it
traps.openmeteo-waves.json: captured 2026-09-28T05:35Z from the marine API (D-125): the sea's points in a fixed UTC-8 zone, not California's daylight time; Escondido ashore answers nothing
traps.ndfd-waves.xml: captured 2026-09-28T05:35Z with waveh: significant wave height in feet, hourly from the next hour to six days; offshore to 121W; nil ashore
traps.ndfd-days-gust.xml: captured 2026-09-28T23:09Z with wspd, wdir and wgust (D-136): hourly gusts in knots beside the sustained wind; every point of the lattice answered this time, the sea included
traps.ndfd-hour-gust.xml: captured 2026-09-28T23:09Z with begin and wgust: the current hour's gust
traps.openmeteo-gust.json: captured 2026-09-28T23:09Z with wind_gusts_10m hourly and wind_gusts_10m_max daily (D-136), km/h
traps.openmeteo-uv.json: captured 2026-09-29T00:51Z with uv_index hourly and uv_index_max daily (D-137): the UV falls to 0 after sunset
traps.openmeteo-air.json: captured 2026-09-29T00:51Z from the air-quality API (D-138): us_aqi hourly, five days, no daily value - each day's worst worked out on the point's own date
